title: The Breakfast & Brunch Plant Board
seo_title: Vegan Brunch Board for 6–8: Shopping List & Plan
description: A vegan brunch board for 6–8: avocado, vegan cream cheese, almond butter, berries, banana, granola, bagel crisps, sourdough toast, jam and maple or agave.
hook: A build-your-own brunch board: toast and bagel crisps with avocado, vegan cream cheese, almond butter, berries and jam, so everyone makes their own perfect bite.
why: Brunch boards work when there's a savoury side and a sweet side. Avocado with flaky salt and vegan cream cheese on bagel crisps is the savoury corner; almond butter, banana, berries and jam are the sweet one.
Granola clusters and toasted walnuts add crunch to the soft fruit and spreads, and a dusting of cinnamon on the banana with a drizzle of agave makes it taste like dessert for breakfast.

timeline.what: Take the vegan cream cheese out of the fridge; toast the sourdough.
Fill bowls with the spreads and jam; wash the berries.
Place the bagel crisps, toast and granola around the bowls.
Slice the banana; dust it with cinnamon.
Slice the avocado last, sprinkle with salt, and serve.

faq.a: Yes, every item is plant-based. Check the labels on crackers, breads and store-bought dips, which sometimes contain butter, milk, honey or egg.

faq.q: How do I stop the avocado and banana browning?
faq.a: Slice them last, right before serving, and squeeze a little lemon juice over the avocado.

faq.q: How many people does it serve?
faq.a: 6 to 8 people as an appetizer, on a 14–18 inch board.
